# Regal Residencia

> Regal Residencia is a premier GMADA-approved luxury residential development by GDPL located in Sector 114, Mohali, Punjab. The project offers ultra-luxury 3 BHK, 3+1 BHK (with servant room), and 4+1 BHK spacious apartments featuring modern architecture, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity to Chandigarh and Airport Road.

## Key Information
- Developer: GDPL (Gillco Group venture)
- Location: Sector 114, Kharar-Landran Road, Mohali, Punjab 160011, India
- Status: GMADA Approved, RERA Registered
- Apartment Types: 3 BHK, 3+1 BHK with servant/store, 4+1 BHK luxury suites
- Phone: +91 7789000077
- Email: info@regalresidenciamohali.com
- Website: https://www.regalresidenciamohali.com/

## Key Features & Amenities
- Multi-tier 24/7 Gated Security & Surveillance
- Modern Clubhouse, Swimming Pool, and Fully Equipped Gymnasium
- Landscaped Green Gardens & Dedicated Children's Play Zone
- High-Speed Elevators & 100% Power Backup
- EV Charging Stations & Ample Covered Parking
- Prime Location with seamless access to Chandigarh Airport Road, VR Punjab Mall, and Educational Hubs (CGC Landran, Chandigarh University)
